subject: DPA redlines + SCCs/UK IDTA questions — transfer impact evidence & DocuSign plan
messages:
From: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@fintera.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@fintera.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA redlines + SCCs / UK IDTA questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — we had a productive internal follow-up. Attached are our initial DPA redlines (Fintera_DPA_redlines_20260908.pdf). A few items we want to surface early:

- Transfer mechanism: we'd like confirmation whether Redwood intends to rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021 SCCs) or an alternative. If SCCs, will you provide a fully populated Annex I-II/III and confirm controller-to-processor mapping?
- UK transfers: we saw a short note about an "IDTA addendum" — please confirm whether you will sign the UK IDTA addendum or propose equivalent UK transfer language.
- Subprocessors / evidence: procurement needs an exportable subprocessor inventory and a short transfer-impact summary (where data goes, key subprocessors, encryption, access controls). Can you provide those artifacts?
- Signing: procurement has asked for a target timeline and DocuSign envelope so they can route internally.

Can you confirm what you can provide by EOD Friday (9/11)? Also calling out two clauses where we've redlined more extensively (sections 4.2 and 8.1) — happy to take those in a call if helpful.

Appreciate it — I copied our Legal Ops mailbox for tracking.

Regards,
Tom Weaver
Head of Platform Partnerships
Fintera Systems

Attachment: Fintera_DPA_redlines_20260908.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@fintera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs / UK IDTA questions

Tom — thanks for the redlines and clear asks. Quick summary of what we can provide and next steps:

1) Transfer mechanism: Redwood will rely on the 2021 EU SCCs between controller-processor. We'll prepare populated SCC Annexes (Annex I: processing details; Annex II: technical & organizational measures; Annex III: SCC clauses) and share them by COB 9/10.

2) UK IDTA: we are comfortable executing the UK Addendum (IDTA) as an addendum to the DPA. Rishi will propose a narrow change to retention wording; if that is acceptable to you we'll include it in the DocuSign packet.

3) Subprocessor inventory & transfer-impact summary: attaching the current Q2 subprocessor list (subprocessor_inventory_Q2-2026.csv) and a one-page transfer-impact summary (transfer-impact-summary-09-08.docx). These include host regions, subprocessors, and high-level controls. If procurement needs an additional attestation (SOC2 coverage for specific subprocessors), we can provide supporting auditor statements under NDA.

4) DocuSign / timeline: we can assemble a final DPA + UK addendum and send a DocuSign envelope once you confirm the narrow Rishi redline. Proposed timeline: internal review today (Rishi), share populated SCCs by 9/10, DocuSign 9/11–9/13. If you need faster execution, let us know.

Action items:
- Rishi: formal position on redlines and proposed language (will follow).
- Marissa: coordinate procurement/billing commercial clarifications and notify if they need a separate PO process.
- Tom: confirm you can accept the UK Addendum with Rishi's narrow retention language, or propose alternative.

Thanks — copying Rishi and Marissa.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Revenue Operations (on privacy coordination)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_Q2-2026.csv, transfer-impact-summary-09-08.docx

Looping in here — procurement flag: Fintera also wants a single-signature DocuSign flow (legal sign + ops countersign) and a billing start date that aligns with go-live (targeting Oct 1). If legal is OK with the UK addendum language, I can confirm commercial and lock the order form.

Also: if we delay on SCC population we risk delaying their procurement queue. Would be good to prioritize the populated Annex I (processing details) so procurement can attach it to their internal packet.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tom Weaver <tom.weaver@fintera.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: RE: DPA redlines + SCCs / UK IDTA questions

Tom — thanks for the redlines. A few legal points and the direct asks: 

- SCCs: Redwood will execute the 2021 EU SCCs for controller-processor relationships. We are preparing populated Annex I/II/III. Annex II (TOMs) references our published security whitepaper; I included a copy link in the Drive folder.

- UK IDTA addendum: Redwood will sign the standard UK Addendum with a limited edit to the retention clause to reflect industry-standard deletion timelines for cached inference KV data (proposed language: "transient inference caches are retained no longer than 30 days unless otherwise required"). If Fintera cannot accept this exact wording, propose alternate language and we can escalate.

- Subprocessor evidence: attached is the current inventory and a CSV export suitable for procurement ingestion. For subprocessors that are not covered by our SOC2 attestation, we can provide scoped independent audit statements under an NDA per your request.

- Transfer impact summary: see attached one-pager. Key points: data transfer flows to EU/US-hosted processing nodes and to select managed infra partners; data is encrypted in transit and at rest; access is limited to engineering & SRE roles with just-in-time admin access.

If Fintera is comfortable with the retention wording above, Redwood will prepare the final DPA + UK Addendum and send a DocuSign envelope. Please confirm whether procurement requires any additional signature order or a PO number on the DocuSign cover letter.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
Redwood Inference

Attachments: subprocessor_inventory_Q2-2026.csv, transfer-impact-summary-09-08.docx

From: Legal Ops <legalops@fintera.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + SCCs / UK IDTA questions

Hi Stephanie / Rishi — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Procurement reviewed the subprocessor CSV and the transfer-impact one-pager; that is sufficient for their initial intake. A couple final notes before we sign: 

- We accept Redwood's approach to use the 2021 SCCs.
- The UK IDTA addendum looks acceptable if you keep the proposed retention clarification; procurement prefers the 30-day transit/cache cap you proposed.
- We have one minor proposed edit to section 4.2 (data subject rights cooperation) — attached mark-up in the PDF. This is limited to a small procedural clarification and does not change the substantive obligation.

Please proceed to assemble the final DPA + UK Addendum including your populated SCC Annexes and the small 4.2 tweak from our markup. Once assembled, please send a DocuSign envelope to legalops@fintera.com and tom.weaver@fintera.com. Our preferred signature order: Fintera sign first (Tom), Redwood countersign.

We are ready to execute on Thursday 9/11 or Friday 9/12 — please confirm when we should expect the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks,
Legal Ops
Fintera Systems

DocuSign envelope requested: https://www.docusign.com/transactions/XYZ123
